headline: A 2020 executive order aimed at helping the U.S. seafood industry compete and grow.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to take steps meant to make the American seafood industry more competitive and to support its economic growth. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, rules, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at the seafood industry, so federal actions under it would most directly affect people who catch, farm, process, or sell seafood in the U.S.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that oversee fishing and seafood
who_it_affects.how: Under an executive order, these agencies would be the ones directed to carry out its instructions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 7, 2020. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, but any later deadlines are not stated in the material provided.
